have key : ∀ l1 l2 (s : List.Sublist l1 l2), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) s ∧ motive l1 l2 s := by intro l1 l2 s; induction s <;> refine ⟨?b, F _ _ _ ?b⟩ <;> constructor <;> simp_all

have key : ∀ l1 l2 (s : List.Sublist l1 l2), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) s ∧ motive l1 l2 s := by intro l1 l2 s; induction s <;> exact ⟨by constructor <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.1) <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.2), F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.1) <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.2))⟩
